title: Lint tests share one folder-removal helper
why: Build advisor, Oct 27 07:10 CDT: five lint tests (check_mod_versions, glossary, hook_stubs, record_slugs, ruling_kind) copy the same rm_tree helper; a git auto-gc race in it turned batch #690 red three times.
note: The race itself is fixed in gates.yml's env (gc.auto=0, maintenance.auto=false; lane ci-mod-versions-no-gc, batch #690). Move rm_tree to one shared test helper and call it from all five (building-one-home-per-capability). Needs no answer. Port: no; the tests live in claude-settings. Placed ahead of c123 (triage, Oct 27): small, and it closes a race that cost three CI runs.
